sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves the required ship-owned applicability and approval/compliance constraints, the ship-to-dischargeDistanceRecords relationship, both required distance properties on each record, decimal quantity values, and nautical-mile units. The non-applicable alternative correctly permits an absent or false treatment-plant selector while excluding the true case. No vocabulary matching or further repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add the missing ship-owned property nltl:marpolAnnexIvRegulation9Point1Point1Or9Point2Point1CertificationStatus to the true applicability branch, with exactly one value constrained to the verified approved/compliant controlled status. The candidate currently omits the required MARPOL Annex IV regulation 9.1.1 or 9.2.1 certification condition, so it does not encode the complete composite obligation. Preserve the existing ship-to-dischargeDistanceRecords relationship and both distance properties on each record; no vocabulary matcher is needed because the missing canonical term is already supplied in the retrieved vocabulary.

The previously requested certification-status condition is now present and correctly constrained to nltl:evidenceStateApproved; preserve that repair. Add sh:minCount 1 to the nltl:hasDischargeDistanceRecord property in the applicable branch. The requirement says both discharge distances shall be recorded, so the current relationship is optional and allows the applicable branch to pass with no discharge-distance record. Keep the existing record shape, both distance properties, quantity datatypes, and nautical-mile unit constraints unchanged.

Preserve the existing certification-status repair, applicable-branch constraints, record relationship, distance properties, quantity datatypes, and nautical-mile units. The non-applicable alternative is too strict: it requires an explicit false value for sewageDischargeUsesTreatmentPlant, although the requirement imposes obligations only when that verified selector is true. Replace that branch with a guard that permits the selector to be absent or false and only excludes the true case, so missing applicability evidence cannot pass the applicable branch. Also, the COMPLETE dependency contract lists the ship-owned direct constraints marpolCertificationStatus and marpolDischargeStatus; add them to the applicable branch with exactly one approved value and exactly one true xsd:boolean value respectively, unless the contract is corrected to remove these legacy terms.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves the required ship-owned applicability and approval/compliance constraints, the ship-to-dischargeDistanceRecords relationship, both required distance properties on each record, decimal quantity values, and nautical-mile units. The non-applicable alternative correctly permits an absent or false treatment-plant selector while excluding the true case. No vocabulary matching or further repair is required.
